DHD.settings.operationMode.name: Operation Mode
DHD.settings.operationMode.hint: Choose how distance rings are triggered.
DHD.settings.visualSettingsMenu.name: Visual Settings
DHD.settings.visualSettingsMenu.label: Open Visual Settings
DHD.settings.visualSettingsMenu.hint: Configure the appearance of the distance rings: colors, lines, effects, and labels.
DHD.settings.broadcastDuration.name: Broadcast Duration (Seconds)
DHD.settings.broadcastDuration.hint: How long the rings remain visible when broadcasted by the GM.
DHD.settings.coverageThreshold.name: Grid Coverage Threshold
DHD.settings.coverageThreshold.hint: How much of the token must be inside the range to count? (0.01 = just touching, 0.5 = 50% coverage).
DHD.settings.calculationMode.name: Calculation Mode
DHD.settings.calculationMode.hint: Choose how elevation affects distance measurement.
DHD.settings.textSize.name: Text Size
DHD.settings.textSize.hint: Choose the size of the text labels.
DHD.settings.colorPalette.name: Color Palette
DHD.settings.colorPalette.hint: Choose the color theme for the distance rings.
DHD.settings.lineStyle.name: Line Style
DHD.settings.lineStyle.hint: Choose the line style for the distance rings.
DHD.settings.lineThickness.name: Line Thickness
DHD.settings.lineThickness.hint: Adjust the thickness of the distance rings.
DHD.settings.fillStyle.name: Gradient Fill Style
DHD.settings.fillStyle.hint: Choose the style of the gradient fill.
DHD.settings.targetHighlighting.name: Target Highlighting
DHD.settings.targetHighlighting.hint: Highlight tokens that are inside your range rings with the corresponding color.
DHD.keybindings.toggleRings.name: Toggle Combat Distances
DHD.keybindings.toggleRings.hint: Toggle the distance rings for the selected token(s). Default: R
DHD.keybindings.broadcastRings.name: Broadcast Rings (GM Only)
DHD.keybindings.broadcastRings.hint: Shows rings to ALL players for a short duration. Default: Shift+R
DHD.keybindings.massMeasurement.name: Mass Measurement
DHD.keybindings.massMeasurement.hint: Toggle mass measurement from the center of selected tokens. Default: M
DHD.keybindings.transientHoverGM.name: Temporary Hover Mode (GM)
DHD.keybindings.transientHoverGM.hint: While held, activates Hover Mode (GM) regardless of the Operation Mode setting. Default: Shift+H
While held, activates Hover Mode (Broadcast) regardless of the Operation Mode setting. Default: Shift+B
DHD.keybindings.clearAll.name: Clear All Distance Rings
DHD.keybindings.clearAll.hint: Remove all active distance rings from all tokens on the scene. Default: Ctrl+Alt+C
DHD.notification.selectTokensMeasure: Daggerheart Distances: Select tokens to measure from.
DHD.notification.selectOrHoverToken: Daggerheart Distances: Select or hover over a token first.
